title: What if you slept like a dolphin? (half your brain stays awake)
description:
Dolphins can sleep with half their brain while the other half stays awake, often with one eye open. Why do they do it, and what would happen if YOU could?
Bix dives into unihemispheric sleep, a 15-day dolphin experiment, birds that nap mid-flight, and the tiny version your own brain already does.

Chapters:
0:00 Half asleep
0:18 One brain, two shifts
0:41 One eye open
0:55 Why bother?
1:42 The 15-day test
1:56 Not just dolphins
2:15 You already do it (a little)
2:35 The full dolphin upgrade
2:49 The catch
3:26 No free hours
3:40 Back in the lab
